cohort: 750 pregnant women after 28 weeks of gestation undergoing their first cesarean section between December 2016 and June 2018 at Central Referral Hospital of Sikkim Manipal Institute of Medical Sciences, Gangtok, Sikkim, India.
finding: The primary cesarean section rate was 27.38% (of all births) and the total cesarean section rate was 49.59%, much higher than the WHO's recommended 15%.
